report_title: [SYNTHETIC TEST] Forest Recovery Investigation: Tillari Corridor Forest Recovery
summary: Autonomous vision analysis identified a compact_block of 6.50 ha (+/- 0.57 ha) at coordinates 15.8225 N, 74.1450 E between 2021-03-10 and 2024-03-15. Investigation mode: offline_simulated. Public records research linked the event to Compensatory Ecological Afforestation / Corridor Protection. Investigation status: concluded_with_evidence.
detailed_findings: OpenCV 5 classical computer vision detected a significant forest recovery candidate covering 650 raster pixels (6.50 ha). The candidate region exhibited a major-to-minor aspect ratio of 2.94 and a compactness of 0.633. Investigation of public registries retrieved 6 records (Execution: offline_simulated). Estimated tree impact ranges from 1560 to 2925 trees, based on Forest Survey of India (FSI) National Forest Inventory & Regional Working Plan Inventories (trees >= 10 cm DBH).

likely_causes_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Canopy roughness gain observed within the Tillari Conservation Reserve landscape (declared 2020), where forest department and conservation trusts focus on corridor connectivity.

linked_entities_or_projects.role: Custodial authority for the Tillari Conservation Reserve.

unresolved_questions_and_unknowns: Whether regeneration is natural secondary succession or planted nursery saplings is not distinguished by satellite imagery alone.

tree_count_estimate.forest_type: Western Ghats Southern Moist Mixed Deciduous Forest (Champion & Seth Class 3B/C2)
tree_count_estimate.density_source: Forest Survey of India (FSI) National Forest Inventory & Regional Working Plan Inventories (trees >= 10 cm DBH)
tree_count_estimate.calculation_basis: Calculated from measured area (6.50 ha) multiplied by documented density range (240 - 450 stems/ha with DBH >= 10 cm) from Forest Survey of India (FSI) National Forest Inventory & Regional Working Plan Inventories (trees >= 10 cm DBH).
tree_count_estimate.limitations: Estimate reflects potential stems (DBH >= 10 cm) based on published stratified regional inventories. Does not reflect local slope variations, rock outcrops, or selective harvesting.
